description: Compute alcohol units (UK) and grams of pure alcohol in a drink. Use for health tracking and limit awareness. Inputs: volume mL, ABV %. Returns UK units, grams of pure alcohol, and standard-drink equivalent. See list_bundles for related 'cuisine' calculators.
name: calculate_alcohol_units

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").
